entries.title: Proverbs 5:1
segments: ¶My son, give attention to my wisdom; let your ear be turned to my teaching:

entries.title: Proverbs 5:2
segments: So that you may be ruled by a wise purpose, and your lips may keep knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:3
segments: For honey is dropping from the lips of the strange woman, and her mouth is smoother than oil;

entries.title: Proverbs 5:4
segments: But her end is bitter as wormwood, and sharp as a two-edged sword;

entries.title: Proverbs 5:5
segments: Her feet go down to death, and her steps to the underworld;

entries.title: Proverbs 5:6
segments: She never keeps her mind on the road of life; her ways are uncertain, she has no knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:7
segments: Give ear to me then, my sons, and do not put away my words from you.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:8
segments: Go far away from her, do not come near the door of her house;

entries.title: Proverbs 5:9
segments: For fear that you may give your honour to others, and your wealth to strange men:

entries.title: Proverbs 5:10
segments: And strange men may be full of your wealth, and the fruit of your work go to the house of others;

entries.title: Proverbs 5:11
segments: And you will be full of grief at the end of your life, when your flesh and your body are wasted;

entries.title: Proverbs 5:12
segments: And you will say, How was teaching hated by me, and my heart put no value on training;

entries.title: Proverbs 5:13
segments: I did not give attention to the voice of my teachers, my ear was not turned to those who were guiding me!

entries.title: Proverbs 5:14
segments: I was in almost all evil in the company of the people.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:15
segments: ¶Let water from your store and not that of others be your drink, and running water from your fountain.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:16
segments: Let not your springs be flowing in the streets, or your streams of water in the open places.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:17
segments: Let them be for yourself only, not for other men with you.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:18
segments: Let blessing be on your fountain; have joy in the wife of your early years.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:19
segments: As a loving hind and a gentle doe, let her breasts ever give you rapture; let your passion at all times be moved by her love.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:20
segments: Why let yourself, my son, go out of the way with a strange woman, and take another woman in your arms?

entries.title: Proverbs 5:21
segments: For a man's ways are before the eyes of the Lord, and he puts all his goings in the scales.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:22
segments: The evil-doer will be taken in the net of his crimes, and prisoned in the cords of his sin.

entries.title: Proverbs 5:23
segments: He will come to his end for need of teaching; he is so foolish that he will go wandering from the right way.
